title: A Rivergate for the Current
author: Silas Okafor
blurb: Felix Underhill, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
